mapper.sql: select user1.tenant_id, user1.revision, user1.created_by, user1.created_time, user1.updated_by, user1.updated_time, user1.deleted_flag, user1.deleted_by, user1.deleted_time, user1.id, user1.remark, user1.login_name, user1.nick_name, user1.user_type, user1.email, user1.phone, user1.password, user1.gender, user1.avatar, user1.status, user1.identity_num, user1.organization_id, user1.department_id, org.data_scope from system_user_base as user1 left join system_user_service_org org on org.organization_id = user1.organization_id and org.user_id = user1.id and org.deleted_flag = 'N'

select.if: select count(1) from system_user_base as user1 where login_name = #{loginName} limit 1
select top 1 count(1) from system_user_base as user1 where login_name = #{loginName}

choose.when: select id, phone from system_user_base as user1 where phone = #{phoneNumber} and deleted_flag = 'N' limit 1
select top 1 id, phone from system_user_base as user1 where phone = #{phoneNumber} and deleted_flag = 'N'

select.if: select id, email from system_user_base as user1 where email = #{email} and deleted_flag = 'N' limit 1
select top 1 id, email from system_user_base as user1 where email = #{email} and deleted_flag = 'N'

mapper.update: update system_user_base set avatar = #{avatar} where login_name = #{loginName} and deleted_flag = 'N'
update system_user_base set password = #{password} where login_name = #{loginName} and deleted_flag = 'N'
mapper.select: select user1.created_by, user1.created_time, user1.updated_by, user1.updated_time, user1.id, user1.remark, user1.login_name, user1.nick_name, user1.user_type, user1.email, user1.phone, user1.password, user1.password_v2, user1.gender, user1.avatar, user1.status, user1.identity_num, user1.organization_id, user1.department_id, org.organization_name from system_user_base as user1 left join system_organization org on org.id = user1.organization_id where user1.login_name = #{loginName} and user1.deleted_flag = 'N' and org.deleted_flag = 'N' and org.status = 1

select user1.created_by, user1.created_time, user1.updated_by, user1.updated_time, user1.id, user1.remark, user1.login_name, user1.nick_name, user1.user_type, user1.email, user1.phone, user1.password, user1.password_v2, user1.gender, user1.avatar, user1.status, user1.identity_num, user1.organization_id, user1.department_id, org.organization_name from system_user_base as user1 left join system_organization org on org.id = user1.organization_id where user1.phone = #{phone} and user1.deleted_flag = 'N' and org.deleted_flag = 'N' and org.status = 1

select user1.created_by, user1.created_time, user1.updated_by, user1.updated_time, user1.id, user1.remark, user1.login_name, user1.nick_name, user1.user_type, user1.email, user1.phone, user1.password, user1.gender, user1.avatar, user1.status, user1.identity_num, serorg.organization_id, serorg.department_id, org.organization_name from system_user_base as user1 left join system_user_service_org serorg on serorg.user_id = user1.id left join system_organization org on org.id = serorg.organization_id where user1.id = #{userId} and user1.deleted_flag = 'N' and serorg.organization_id = #{orgId} and serorg.deleted_flag = 'N' and org.deleted_flag = 'N'

select distinct user1.id, user1.remark, user1.login_name, user1.nick_name, user1.user_type, user1.email, user1.phone, user1.gender, user1.avatar, user1.status, user1.identity_num, user1.organization_id, user1.department_id from system_user_base as user1 left join system_role_user as roleUser on roleUser.user_id = user1.id left join system_role as role on role.id = roleUser.role_id and role.status = 1 and role.deleted_flag = 'N' left join system_role_user_dept as roleUserDept on roleUserDept.role_user_id = roleUser.id
user1.deleted_flag = 'N' and user1.status = 1 and roleUser.deleted_flag = 'N' and ( roleUserDept.deleted_flag = 'N' or roleUserDept.deleted_flag is null)
and (user1.department_id = #{departmentId} or roleUserDept.department_id = #{departmentId})
and roleUser.role_id in
#{roleId}

select distinct user1.id, user1.remark, user1.login_name, user1.nick_name, user1.user_type, user1.email, user1.phone, user1.gender, user1.avatar, user1.status, user1.identity_num, user1.organization_id, user1.department_id from system_user_base as user1 left join system_role_user as roleUser on roleUser.user_id = user1.id left join system_role as role on role.id = roleUser.role_id and role.status = 1 left join system_role_user_dept as roleUserDept on roleUserDept.role_user_id = roleUser.id
user1.deleted_flag = 'N' and user1.status = 1 and role.deleted_flag = 'N' and roleUser.deleted_flag = 'N' and ( roleUserDept.deleted_flag = 'N' or roleUserDept.deleted_flag is null) and role.role_key = #{roleCode}) and role.organization_id = #{organizationId} and (role.department_id = #{departmentId} or (user1.department_id = #{departmentId} or roleUserDept.department_id = #{departmentId} ))

select distinct user1.id, user1.remark, user1.login_name, user1.nick_name, user1.user_type, user1.email, user1.phone, user1.gender, user1.avatar, user1.status, user1.identity_num, user1.organization_id, user1.department_id from system_user_base as user1 left join system_user_group_user as userGroupUser on userGroupUser.user_id = user1.id left join system_user_group as userGroup on userGroupUser.group_id = userGroup.id and userGroup.status = 1
user1.deleted_flag = 'N' and user1.status = 1 and userGroup.deleted_flag = 'N' and userGroupUser.deleted_flag = 'N' and userGroup.department_id = #{departmentId} and userGroup.organization_id = #{organizationId} and userGroup.group_code = #{groupCode}

select user1.created_by, user1.created_time, user1.id, user1.remark, user1.login_name, user1.nick_name, user1.user_type, user1.email, user1.phone, user1.gender, user1.avatar, user1.status, user1.identity_num, serorg.organization_id, serorg.department_id, org.organization_name from system_user_service_org serorg left join system_user_base as user1 on serorg.user_id = user1.id left join system_organization org on org.id = serorg.organization_id where user1.id = #{userId} and user1.deleted_flag = 'N' and serorg.deleted_flag = 'N' and org.deleted_flag = 'N'
